0022600194.text: The Phoenix Suns (2-5, 12th in the West, 3rd in the Pacific and 4 games back, on a one-game winning streak) host the Houston Rockets (7-2, 1st in the Southwest and 2nd in the West, on a one-game losing streak) in the Suns' eighth game of the 2026-27 season. Phoenix is without Mark Williams (out, shoulder surgery), and Jordan Goodwin (calf) and Rasheer Fleming (ankle sprain) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions, while Houston is missing Clint Capela (out, ankle sprain) and Steven Adams (out, calf strain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Suns lost 0-4 in the season series, including a 119-105 loss in Phoenix on April 7, 2026.
